message: Thanks, Cindy, Joanna. The body text is (should be) dark gray, and only the titles actually black; some of the sidebar stuff, medium gray; followed links in body text, light gray. Joanna, the title for the [picture](/weblog/archives/2005/05/11/in-hoc-signo-vinces/) translates: "In this sign thou shalt conquer." A little surrealism via [the emperor Constantine](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Constantine_the_Great).
